"'''Journey to the Bracca Badlands / The Search for the Missing Dunnels'''" is the nineteenth episode of the [[Young Jedi Adventures Season Two|second season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]]''. It was released on [[Disney+]] on [[March 19]], [[2025]].

{{Media-stub}}

''Jedi aid in a search. Lys wrangles escaped creatures.''
